s: This was the second basket kit I made from this company. It was a rather confusing one to start with some unwieldy reeds but as soon as I got a few rows up, it got easier. I apparently missed it when I first read through the instructions, but be sure to leave a 5 foot piece of the half round reed out for the handle-wrap. I cut all of it for the basket, and had to use flat reed to make the handle wrap. Other than that it came out really well, and the instructions were clear. I would buy additional kits from this company.
